title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.00 (quiet) at 02:00 UTC on 30 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 30 日 02:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.00 (1Z) at 02:00 UTC on 30 September 2026. The 02:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 02:59; hour-start 1.00/1Z, hour-end 1.00/1Z). Last-180 maximum is 1.00 (first at 2026-09-30T01:51:00Z; label 1Z). Published-window maximum is 1.33 (first at 2026-09-29T23:16:00Z; label 1P). Window start 2026-09-29T21:58:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 03:00 UTC on 30 September 2026 hour is still incomplete (56 samples through 03:55).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The public feed is a rolling ~6-hour window, not a full-day archive.
evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (02:00 UTC on 30 September 2026). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
